question: Which Indian fencer secured the bronze medal in the women's Cadet Epee category at the 2022 Asian Junior and Cadet Fencing Championships?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prachi Lohan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Prachi Lohan secured the bronze medal in the women's Cadet Epee category at the 2022 Asian Junior and Cadet Fencing Championships held in Uzbekistan.
 
• She is one of the promising young talents in Indian fencing, representing the nation on international platforms.
 
• This achievement highlights India's growing presence in international fencing competitions, showcasing the potential of Indian athletes in the sport.
 
• The Asian Junior and Cadet Fencing Championships is a prestigious event where young fencers from across Asia compete in different categories.
 
• Prachi Lohan's achievement is a significant milestone for Indian fencing, inspiring upcoming athletes to pursue the sport at competitive levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhavani Devi**

 
 
• Bhavani Devi is the first Indian fencer to qualify for the Olympics. She represented India at the Tokyo Olympics in 2021.
 
• She specializes in the sabre category of fencing and has won several medals in international competitions.
 
• Bhavani Devi is a role model for aspiring Indian fencers, paving the way for the sport's growth in the country.
 
 
 
• **C.A. Bhavya**
 
 
• C.A. Bhavya is another Indian fencer who has participated in various national and international fencing tournaments.
 
• She has shown promising skills in her category but has yet to secure a medal at major international championships like the Asian Junior and Cadet Fencing Championships.
 
 
 
• **Kushi Chaudhary**
 
 
• Kushi Chaudhary is an Indian fencer who has represented the country in several junior-level fencing competitions.
 
• Although she has not achieved a medal at the 2022 Asian Junior and Cadet Fencing Championships, she is considered a potential talent in the sport.
 
 
 
• **Fencing in India**
 
 
• Fencing is a relatively new and developing sport in India, gaining recognition in recent years due to achievements by athletes like Bhavani Devi and others.
 
• The Fencing Association of India (FAI) is the governing body responsible for organizing and promoting the sport in the country.
 
• India is investing in infrastructure, training, and international exposure to enhance the performance of its fencers on the global stage.
